description: This file defines the ShipmentEvents class in the org.apache.ofbiz.shipment.shipment package. It contains server-side event handler methods related to shipment processing, such as displaying shipment package route segment labels as images and force marking shipments as received. It interacts with the OFBiz entity engine, HTTP requests/responses, and services.

classes.name: ShipmentEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling shipment-related web events such as viewing shipment labels and updating shipment status.

methods.name: viewShipmentPackageRouteSegLabelImage
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve and stream the label image for a shipment package route segment. Determines image format dynamically, handles errors if label data is missing or stream fails.

methods.name: checkForceShipmentReceived
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to force mark a shipment as received by invoking an OFBiz service. Checks request parameters and handles service errors.
